page.about.title: Who is behind Eranitor
page.about.lead: An academic project with a simple goal: helping students organize their routine without spreadsheets, loose notebooks or scattered apps.
page.about.missionP1: We believe most study struggles are not lack of effort. They are lack of organization. That is why we built Eranitor as an assistant: it does not study for you, but it helps you plan what, when and how long to study.
page.about.missionP2: We do not promise guaranteed admission or automatic results. What we offer is clarity: one place to organize subjects, follow tasks and truly see your progress.

page.about.originTitle: A common problem, a simple answer
page.about.originLead: Eranitor was born from watching real student routines: a lot of effort, little clarity about where that effort goes.
page.about.signal.0.title: Scattered routine
page.about.signal.0.text: Subjects in notebooks, deadlines in memory, tasks in different apps. Nothing talks to each other.
page.about.signal.1.title: Hard to prioritize
page.about.signal.1.text: Without knowing what to study first, energy goes to the wrong place in exam week.
page.about.signal.2.title: Invisible progress
page.about.signal.2.text: Hours of study without knowing if you are close to the week's goal.
page.about.solutionText: Swap improvisation for a weekly cycle: plan, study, log, review, adapt and improve, all in one place.
page.about.quote: “Eranitor doesn't study for you. It organizes so you study better.”
